title: Raise conditional κ to 0.0038901152865907 with a smaller signed margin
body:
## Result

**Conditional κ ≥ 0.0038901152865907** for the full paired integer multiplier. That is `0.0000000000002387` above [#8033](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8033). A second installation at #8033's original BIT and positive carrier ranks and sufficient activation certifies **conditional κ ≥ 0.0038901152863924**.

The positive recursion now takes a profile-bound stopping exponent. The exact integer comparison pays a whole leaf only below its actual cutoff. An all-size leaf and depth proof permits `g = 10^-17`, and both paid supplier caps fund the rechecked signed inequalities. The fixed-stock profile retains the 268-factor BIT certificate, 21-bit BIT debit, and sufficient public activation exponent `119466661575676`. The near-crossing profile pays 22 BIT bits at 285 factors and increases the largest binary rank exponent by 64 to `7168000000000000`. Its sufficient public activation exponent is `7645866239991957`. Both retain the full 10-bit positive price and all 36 BIT and 48 rational calls.

The strongest complete lower is about `3.76113e-15` below the fixed-word raw upper. [#8034](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8034) proves that the conservative Cartesian-support pruning rule cannot cross that endpoint at any finite power.

## Exact sources and overlap

- Canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` and the separate CI support commit `0618e75a22cec54d1651394ef83d088551b7f026` used by #8029, #8032 and #8033.
- [#8030](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8030) exact standalone tape source `6285dd829114705862e8d91facaedc1f31d3cfcb` and [#8027](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8027) paired suppliers `fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4`.
- #8033 exact `a1313ff9f84fd00d50b282fe432e522191277821` supplies the improved split-surcharge argument. The signed outer expressions are tied to `4f7c67ae387cc91580f469aeda4d508b372b9ec1` and the actual new single-band supplier caps.

## Replay and scope

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-single-band-signed-margin
```

All eight registered cases passed locally in 807.85 seconds. They cover two independent BIT prices, the retained positive price, 54 strict and four functional signed inequalities per profile, source and runtime stopping checks, exact ownership and precision, and two signed product replays. Each product exercises 138 physical shuttles and 157,248 numerical calls. The tests reject both the original fixed gap and a vanishing gap at the new claims, equality at either paid interface, and excess paid rank-one cost.

The five inherited premises concern all-column native action, owned erasure and restoration, compiler transfer, precision and tape services, and analytic recovery. The production dimensions are certified by the written proof and exact arithmetic. Operator and product executions use finite tapes. The larger installation is a rate and resource tradeoff. Its practical crossover remains open.

## Open next questions

Can a changed literal paid word move the raw crossing? An exact whole-field cancellation with nonempty recorded support, or a paid operator rewrite with complete role and owner checks, would test a route outside #8034's obstruction.

Ali Romman supplied the paired circuits and single-band application. The P104 dual-supplier authors supplied the signed gate machinery. Clear1nsight contributed the stopping transfer, physical policy binding and complete profiles. OpenAI Codex materially assisted the proof and verification.
